information.description:
The most run-of-the-mill Tyger Claw you’ll ever encounter. Screams at you, sprints with a blade or SMG in hand, and definitely for sure aren’t paid to do Arasaka’s dirty work. While not the most dangerous threat in Japantown, Tygers aren’t frail prey either.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Tyger Claws).
